expression: A name earned. A legacy upheld.

usage.navy: Primary fields, headings, body text and light-surface links
usage.steel: Secondary graphics, rules and details on dark surfaces
usage.copper: Restrained emphasis, logo accents, rules and buttons with navy text
usage.salt: Primary light surface and text on navy
usage.accessibility: Use navy on copper and salt; use copper on navy. Do not use copper or steel for small text on salt.

scope: PillarSpec branding only; other company brands remain independent.
logo_policy: Preserve the existing logo geometry and company spelling; this update changes color only.
